title: Wan Sheng Jie: Gubao de Mimi

alternative_titles.en: All Saints Street Special: The Secret of the Old Castle
alternative_titles.ja: 万圣街 特别篇 古堡的秘密

synopsis:
Living together means more than rent, chores, haggling, and bickering... now there are even challenges of life and death?!

A mysterious old castle is calling. Can everyone from the 1031 block keep that neighborly spirit alive and continue getting along through it all?

(Source: Official X Account)
